comparison.objective: Move six crackers to a basket while excluding a desiccant packet.
comparison.physical_skill: Object classification and repeated individual pick-and-place, including partially occluded crackers.
comparison.success_condition: Per-cracker credit after supported release and 1 s stillness; packet entering or touching the basket permanently zeros the run.
comparison.reason: Both require retaining an unwanted item, but this tests semantic selection and individual transfer rather than geometry-based sifting of mixed loose bodies.
